verdict.rationale: Pulley clearly has stock certificates that can be customized (pulley-docs-35) and in-platform e-signing for issued documents (pulley-docs-33, pulley-docs-9). The Signatory Status page sits under Cap Table → Security Status, which suggests signatures are tracked per security (pulley-docs-30), and documents are attached to specific securities (pulley-docs-1). However, the evidence is mostly article titles, and none of it explicitly says electronic share certificates are signed in-platform and permanently tied to their cap table entry. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of electronic certificate issuance with in-platform legal signature, confirmation of a permanent certificate-to-security link, independent or hands-on corroboration.
